name: Reggello (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Reggello (a wreath on maroon above a cross and a bear beneath a tree) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Reggello, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Reggello arms — wreath on maroon above a cross and a bear beneath a tree, crowned, within branches
